races.display_title: Edmundson Electrical CableTec Plymouth Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Having won a couple of points, DEPALMA made a very positive start to life with Dan Skelton at Bangor 2 weeks ago and while this drop back in trip is a slight concern, he can overcome it. Pappano 's well-being is something of an unknown but he has the class to be a major factor in this race if running close to his Flat form on return. DEPALMA (IRE) PAPPANO PENZANCE

races.display_title: Kennet Valley Syndicates Nick Robinson EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: The Roger Teal stable is going better now than when OAKFORD was narrowly denied at Goodwood in June so perhaps this Dark Angel colt can make a successful return from a break. Al Widyan should have more to offer on the back of his Kempton third and is second choice. Hope In Havana and Cornichon are newcomers who could have a say, particularly if the betting speaks in their favour. OAKFORD (IRE) AL WIDYAN HOPE IN HAVANA

races.display_title: Ladbrokes Ayr Bronze Cup Handicap
races.verdict: It might be worth taking a chance on first-time blinkers sparking a revival from EYE OF DUBAI , who was third in last season's Silver Cup off 5 lb higher before going on to defy the same mark at Ripon a week later. Woven 's solid Ayr record (including second in this last year) makes him second choice ahead of Boston Dan , who was back to form with a bang in a tongue tie last time. Wild Clary , French Affair and American Style complete the shortlist. EYE OF DUBAI WOVEN BOSTON DAN (IRE)

races.verdict: Danny Tudhope has a good record for Jim Goldie in recent seasons, and KELPIE GREY looks a sporting each-way angle into a competitive race, if turned out quickly. races.display_title: Kildress Plumbing Suppliers Rated Novice Hurdle
races.verdict: LADY LENA made a winning start over hurdles in a Tramore novice and, with improvement expected, is taken to maintain her unbeaten record in this sphere. Gangster Granny ran poorly on the Flat last time but is a different mare at this track and rates the chief threat, while Brother Walfrid and Mr Master Mac are also respected. LADY LENA (IRE) GANGSTER GRANNY (IRE) BROTHER WALFRID (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Mr Master Mac (10/3), Luker's Tipple (7/2), Harpy Eagle (9/2), Brother Walfrid (11/2), Kashchei (7/1), Gangster Granny (9/1), Lady Lena (9/1), Holy Joe (25/1), Look Sport (28/1)

races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Beginners Chase
races.verdict: WHISPERING WILLOW shaped with encouragement in a couple of starts over fences earlier in the season and, after taking a notable step back in the right direction over hurdles recently, she looks worth siding with in an ordinary maiden chase. Kalsman rarely runs a bad race at this track and rates the main danger after finishing second over fences last time, while Sea of Doubt is another to consider. races.display_title: Dunleath Flat Race
races.verdict: IFUKNOWUKNOW showed some promise in a pair of bumpers last season, including when behind subsequent Champion Bumper winner The Mourne Rambler in a very warm race at Leopardstown when last seen, and he could well be up to making a winning start for his new yard, especially with this slightly longer trip sure to be in his favour. Myluckymaker sets the standard and should give her running once more, while newcomer Thranduil ticks plenty of boxes on paper. IFUKNOWUKNOW (IRE) MYLUCKYMAKER (IRE) THRANDUIL (IRE)
